name: Cornu
text: Cornu is a great black bird of legend that lived in St Patrick's Purgatory on Lough Derg. Oral tradition says the bird was once a demon until Patrick turned it into a bird.

attributes.attribute: legendary black bird of St Patrick's Purgatory
saint who turned the demon into a bird
